items.html: Now, through this introduction, it will become clear to you, and you will understand and comprehend what will be explained from here onward regarding the falling of the posterior of the vessels of Aba and Ima. The matter is this: know that these phases of the Hassadim and Gevurot that grow the posterior of ZON, and return them to face to face, are the phase of the posterior of Aba and Ima that fell, as mentioned above. Therefore, do not wonder that this phase is at times called face and at times called posterior — it concerns these Hassadim and Gevurot, together with the phases that grew in the posterior, all of which fell downward. They are the phases of Hassadim and Gevurot that Aba and Ima take from AA, so that they return to face to face, as is known. For in Aba and Ima, too, there was the phase of their standing back to back, as will be explained.
